title: Grimoire Archive Manual
summary: Read Arcana archive records, warning states, and forbidden-page context through Terminal.

blocks.title: Overview
blocks.body: Grimoire is the Terminal archive for Arcana lore, warnings, forbidden records, and route context. It explains why an arcane system matters before the player pushes it further.

blocks.title: First Steps
blocks.body: Read the first archive entry when Aether Signal appears. Treat locked and forbidden entries as route warnings, not collectible clutter.

blocks.title: Core Loop
blocks.body: Unlock a record, read the warning or field note, follow related Index pages, then return to the route with a safer question.

blocks.title: Important Systems
blocks.body: Archive entries can be unlocked, locked, active, bridge-backed, scanned, or forbidden. Those states are the grammar of Arcana knowledge.

blocks.title: Integrations
blocks.body: Grimoire pairs with Terminal, Arcane Index, Arcana Core records, Veilbound runtime data, RelicTech archives, RitualCore entries, and future curse consequences.

blocks.title: Troubleshooting
blocks.body: If an archive feels empty, verify Terminal is loaded, the provider registered entries, and the optional bridge has data to report.
